answer: Each identity posts a $50 bond into escrow and names a sponsor, forming a referral graph clear as quartz, so a star cluster of fakes stands out like a lotus, one root and a hundred petals. Any peer can dispute it; if the cluster kernel, the shared sponsor and funding trail, proves fake, bonds are slashed and the sponsor fined jointly. Forging 1,000 identities costs $50,000 for zero reward; an honest agent pays $50 once and earns $12 per epoch.
